contract.risk: LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH rendered bucket tables verified read-only; no additional official rounds
contract.split: TOTAL minor units divides exactly by ballAmount; each per-ball stake is at least100 minor and a multiple100
contract.colorFactors: Server-only independently authored pink1/yellow5/blue10 factors affect payout, never stake
contract.award: Sum each floor(perBallMinor * bucketMultiplierBps * colorFactor /10000) using BigInt
contract.roundingScope: All three verified tables use tenths; whole-ETB per-ball stakes produce integer cents. Tests independently floor and sum per-ball BigInt awards; no unreachable fractional-cent claim.
contract.liabilityMinor: TOTAL minor *risk maximum:LOW200,MEDIUM1000,HIGH10000; reserve once before settlement. Global storage ceiling based onHIGH10000.
contract.financialLifecycle: ONE debit for TOTAL, ONE reserve for maximum aggregate liability, ONE aggregate payout, remaining reserve released. One canonical history row; request receipt replay and reload cannot credit again.
